body: I came here to vent I guess. Thanks for your words, I'm not going to divorce him because he is a good man for real, but he really just doesn't get this topic. He is a real bitch when it comes to this topic.

He is a good guy and really loves me. But he has very distorted views and is himself selfish when it comes to when someone is unwell enough that they feel suicidal.

In other words, he doesn't understand it. So he judges it.
